title: Storage Addendum Schedule — Minimum Rental, Notice and Change Terms
content:
Each Storage Rental product sets its own minimum rental, written notice to end the rental and early termination fee; the fee to move to a different storage unit or product and carry-over on an in-community transfer are the same for all six.

| Storage Rental product | Minimum rental (months) | Written notice to end the rental (calendar days) | Early termination fee (months of rent) | Fee to move to a different unit or product | Carries over on an in-community transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bike Storage Locker | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Small Storage Closet (4x4) | 1 | 15 | 0.00 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Standard Storage Unit (5x5) | 1 | 15 | 0.00 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | 3 | 30 | 0.5 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | 3 | 30 | 0.5 | $25.00 | Yes |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | 6 | 30 | 1.00 | $25.00 | Yes |

**Definitions used in the schedule**

- *Minimum rental* is the number of rented months before which a notice cannot end the rental without an early termination fee.
- *Early termination fee* is expressed in months of rent and applies when the end date falls inside the minimum rental.

**Observations on the schedule**

- For the Small Storage Closet (4x4) and the Standard Storage Unit (5x5) the minimum rental is 1 month but the early termination fee is 0.00 months of rent, so an end date inside the minimum rental produces a fee of $0.00.
- For the Bike Storage Locker every figure in the first three columns is 0: there is no minimum rental, no required notice period and no early termination fee.
- The unit or product change fee ($25.00) and carry-over on an in-community transfer (Yes) are the same for all six products.

**Illustration — early termination fee in dollars** (hypothetical rentals whose rent in force is the amount shown)

| Storage Rental product | Hypothetical rent in force | Months of rent | Early termination fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Large Storage Unit (5x10) | $85.00 | 0.5 | $42.50 |
| Climate-Controlled Storage Unit (5x10) | $115.00 | 0.5 | $57.50 |
| Oversized Storage Suite (10x10) | $165.00 | 1.00 | $165.00 |
